requirement: A chat turn is undone only when it is safe: the server refuses with the reason when content changed after it, files moved, a restore happened, a turn is open, the seat lacks the toolset, the change is shared, or the site runs EmDash; otherwise it undoes files then content, newest first, and stops at the first step that did not verifiably succeed

oracle.ref: PR #958 (feat); fix evidence: Measured 05/10/2026 on cowork.tracy.site: undo lived only in Site changes, undid files but not content, and was refused when a later turn touched the same files. WordPress content.replace reverts were measured to overwrite a later edit (tasks/evidence stand-e2e.md:477), so content undo must refuse when anything changed after the turn.
oracle.invariant: 0 failures. 'content changed after the turn in the CMS admin blocks it; a cron row does not' passes. 'files changed after: the host preflight conflict blocks that turn and every older one' passes. 'a restore after the turn blocks it, unless it is the undo of a turn of the run' passes. 'a turn open on the site blocks every turn, and outranks every other reason' passes. 'a missing toolset blocks with the toolset named; going back needs every toolset of the run' passes. 'EmDash: no undo at all' passes. Both SHARED_CHANGE tests pass. 'latest vs from-here: the newest turn that changed something is latest, older ones go back to here' passes. 'runUndo: in order, files before content, and it stops at the first step that did not succeed' passes. 'revertOutcome: only ok:true is a revert; a clean no is failed; silence is unsure' and 'fileOutcome: a verified restore commit is undone; a refusal failed; anything that may have run unsure' pass.
oracle.productSourcesScope: file-level: the files the case imports, reads or runs (declaration line, or the first code line); the invariant is exercised through them, the executed assertion is the case command

writes: run dir under QA_ARTIFACT_ROOT: logs/, tmp/<case> (the child TMPDIR, removed after the run)
